# Förvaltaren om industrijätten: "Vågar inte sälja den"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-08-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The guest fund managers (Mattias and Ulf) discuss Q2 reports from Swedish industrial heavyweights ABB, Alfa Laval, Atlas Copco, Epiroc and Sandvik. They see strong order intake, much of it driven by data-center investment, but valuations look stretched and they doubt the data-center capex surge will last many years. They would not buy these stocks now and would only keep Atlas Copco as a long-term core holding. The main new idea is Intrum, which the manager has just bought after its SEK 7.5bn rights issue: he points to a credible deleveraging plan and new management that bought heavily, and he values the shares at about SEK 7, roughly double today's price.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 INTRUM — Intrum | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Manager just bought after the rights issue. His fair value is ~SEK 7, about 2x the current price, on conservative assumptions.

#### Reasoning

The SEK 7.5bn rights issue cuts net debt from 45bn to 38bn against a ~12bn market cap. The new chair/CEO/CFO team bought in heavily (chair Magnus Lindqvist ~SEK 80m). Servicing margin is ~25% vs a 30-35% target, already proven in Norway. New partner-led, capital-light portfolio investments return ~19-20%. Sum of parts: portfolio slightly above book value plus servicing at 10x EBIT gives ~SEK 7 per share.

#### Sell Triggers

- if deleveraging plan fails to deliver cash flow
- if servicing margin does not improve toward 30-35%
- if portfolio returns fall back to value-destroying levels
- if leverage stays too high or another capital raise is needed

> *"Då får du ett värde på ungefär 7 kronor, vilket är dubbelt så mycket som aktien står i idag. Det tycker jag är rimliga antaganden, inte något som är aggressivt på något sätt."*

---

### 🟡 ATCO-A — Atlas Copco | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Manager owns it and won't sell because of flows and long-term delivery. Too expensive to buy more.

#### Reasoning

The manager admits Atlas Copco is too expensive and always has been. It keeps delivering and adapting, and it recently hit an all-time high. He treats it as a forever holding he mostly ignores and is not adding to it. Only a strategic mistake or a structural change in the industry would change his view.

#### Sell Triggers

- strategic mistake by management
- structural change in the industry

> *"Den är också för dyr egentligen. Men det har den egentligen alltid varit. Alla förvaltare, inklusive jag, äger Akties Shopco. Det är hela tiden flöden in. Så jag vågar inte sälja den."*

---

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Great company, but the valuation assumes data-center capex lasts for many years. Manager wants a further decline before buying.

#### Reasoning

To justify ABB's valuation you have to assume the data-center investment surge lasts many years, which the manager doubts. The stock fell 5% on a strong Q2, which shows how high expectations are. It is very sensitive to Q3/Q4 order intake. He would consider buying only after a further pullback.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3/Q4 order intake misses
- if data-center investment surge fades

> *"Det är svårt att se uppsida i ABB, även om det är ett fantastiskt bolag."*

---

### 🟡 ASSA-B — Assa Abloy | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Named as a forever holding the manager doesn't need to watch closely.

#### Reasoning

The manager groups Assa Abloy with Atlas Copco and AstraZeneca as quality companies he will probably always own. He ignores quarterly details unless there is a strategic mistake or a structural change in the industry.

#### Sell Triggers

- strategic mistake
- structural industry change

> *"Atlas och Assa tycker jag också är en sådan typ av bolag."*

---

### 🟡 AZN — AstraZeneca | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Forever holding despite recent turbulence, because of its research portfolio and culture.

#### Reasoning

The manager says AstraZeneca has an enormously impressive research portfolio and research culture, which he expects to benefit the company for many years. Recent turbulence doesn't change his long-term hold.

#### Sell Triggers

- strategic mistake
- structural change in the pharma industry

> *"Även fast det varit lite stökigt på sistone så har de en enormt imponerande både forskningsportfölj och forskningskultur som jag tror kommer gynna bolaget många år framåt."*

---
